# Omny Studio (Triton Digital)

- Category: host (enterprise)
- Checked: 2026-09-26
- Primary docs: https://www.tritondigital.com/solutions/podcasting/omny-studio

> **Verified 2026-09-26 (P0-03).** This file is the research-pass evidence for one vendor. Pricing, IAB certification and Apple HLS partner cells were rechecked against primary sources; corrections are marked inline. IAB status comes from the [IAB Tech Lab compliance registry](https://iabtechlab.com/compliance-programs/compliant-companies/). Apple's own partner search ([podcastsconnect.apple.com/partner-search](https://podcastsconnect.apple.com/partner-search)) redirects to an Apple ID sign-in, so partner status is attributed to the vendor or trade press, not an Apple list (checked 2026-09-26). The summary and comparison are in [`../vendors.md`](../vendors.md).

## Integration surface

- **API:** Management API (private/admin, full CRUD on organizations, networks, programs, clips/episodes, playlists; v0 frozen/supported, v1 current and adds download analytics, audit events, user management) plus a separate read-only Consumer API for published content/metadata. [Developer Resources Guide](https://help.tritondigital.com/docs/developer-resources-guide) (2026-09-26); [Management API launch post](https://medium.com/omny-studio-product-updates/public-api-launched-2278235f383) (2026-09-26).
- **Webhooks:** Organization-level event-notification subscriptions exist per the developer guide; specific event catalog not accessible (docs are JS-rendered). [Developer Resources Guide](https://help.tritondigital.com/docs/developer-resources-guide) (2026-09-26).
- **Export formats:** Transcript export to WebVTT/SRT is documented; general bulk RSS/media/CSV data export is undocumented on pages checked. [Omny Studio solutions page](https://www.tritondigital.com/solutions/podcasting/omny-studio) (2026-09-26).
- **SSO / auth:** Organization-level 2FA and SSO are supported for user accounts; Management API auth is by API key (org-scoped, rate-limited, no CORS by design). [Omny Studio solutions page](https://www.tritondigital.com/solutions/podcasting/omny-studio) (2026-09-26); [public API launch post](https://medium.com/omny-studio-product-updates/public-api-launched-2278235f383) (2026-09-26).
- **Lock-in risks:** Analytics/download data appears accessible mainly through Omny's own dashboards and the Management API rather than a documented one-click bulk export; IAB-certified download counts are proprietary to Omny's measurement stack. Outbound feed redirect (301) is supported, which mitigates classic RSS lock-in, but no native custom-domain website product means any custom site is a third-party dependency (Beamly/Podpage) layered on top of the Omny feed. Management API keys are org-wide and high-privilege (no CORS), meaning any integration must run server-side, adding integration overhead compared to simpler public APIs.

## Narrative (≤150 words)

Omny Studio is the strongest enterprise-network fit of the vendors reviewed for Relay's core requirements: native org/network/program permissioning, Apple HLS video partner status, human-reviewable transcripts with `podcast:transcript`, Apple Podcasts Subscriptions/premium-feed support, and a genuine read/write Management API plus webhooks. It is also the weakest on transparency: pricing is entirely unpublished/enterprise-sales, comments/community features are undocumented, and there is no documented editorial approval-before-publish gate — only scheduled publish dates — so Relay's "immutable release record with review workflow" would still need to be built on top. API docs are Swagger-rendered and not fully inspectable without an account/key, and full bulk data export (beyond transcripts) isn't documented, which is a real portability question. Net: good multi-show/video/premium/API foundation, but Relay would still own the approval workflow and would need to verify export completeness and true pricing before committing.

## Research notes

- `help.omnystudio.com` individual article URLs (organization/program/network-level access, transcript, custom-domain articles) 301-redirect to a single consolidated page (`help.tritondigital.com/docs/omny-studio`) when fetched directly; content for those specific articles was recovered via search-result snippets of the original vendor pages rather than a direct page fetch. Treated as vendor-sourced since the URLs and snippets originate from Omny's own help center, but flagging the fetch limitation per the hard rules.
- `api.omnystudio.com/docs/management-api-v0` and `-v1` are JS-rendered Swagger UIs; WebFetch could not extract endpoint-level detail (only the page title). Endpoint/auth/rate-limit claims in this report come from Triton's developer-resources guide and the vendor's own "Public API launched" Medium post, not the raw Swagger spec.
- The research pass cited a March 2020 certificate. Verification replaced it with the current IAB registry entry (v2.2, 2025-02-27).
- Pricing: no page found at all on omnystudio.com or tritondigital.com; only third-party aggregator guesses exist, which are not used as sources per the hard rules.
- Comments/community and pre-publish approval workflow: checked the main solutions page, omnystudio.com, and the consolidated help page; found no vendor mention of either, so both are marked undocumented rather than "not supported."
